results.content:
Trump remains weakest among younger voters. Among those aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance, compared with 72 percent who disapprove, according to the newest Civiqs data.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 29 percent, while 63 percent disapprove.

Independents also remain negative, with 28 percent approving and 64 percent disapproving. Women disapprove by a 65-to-30 margin, while men are divided at 53 percent disapprove to 42 percent approve. [...] At a comparable point before those elections, Civiqs polling showed Trump on 43 percent approval and 53 percent disapproval, for a net approval rating of -10. His current net rating of -23 leaves him 13 point

results.content:
Civiqs, a nonpartisan online polling firm that surveys presidential approval on a rolling basis, puts Trump's current approval in Idaho at 49 percent, with 41 percent disapproving as of Thursday. That figure has fluctuated near that line in recent weeks. The Idaho Democratic Party cited the same Civiqs data in a statement released Aug. 19. [...] The shift marks a significant change in a state Trump carried by more than 36 percentage points in the 2024 presidential election and where his approval stood well above 50 percent for most of his second term. Wyoming, North Dakota and West Virginia are currently the only other states where Trump holds a positive approval rating above 50 percent.
